purpose: Phase-8A rechallenge abstraction: ordinal states for renewed treatment after a washout interval. Rechallenge provides EVIDENCE about persistence vs re-sensitization (reduced response on rechallenge supports persistent resistance; restored response supports re-sensitization). Real-world durations are NOT defined without evidence; ordinal simulation stages only.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: rechallenge_response_retention in [0,1] (1 = full response retained, i.e. re-sensitized; lower = reduced response = persistence signal)
coefficient_policy.0_interpretation: 0 = no response on rechallenge (strong persistence signal)
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: retention is an evidence signal feeding the acquired-resistance / re-sensitization evaluation; it is not itself a mechanism.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No real rechallenge timing or dose (NOT_REPORTED).

rechallenge_pending.meaning: Rechallenge scheduled but not yet evaluated.

rechallenge_evaluated.meaning: Rechallenge response evaluated (retention resolved per profile).

rules.requires_prior_washout: A meaningful rechallenge signal requires a preceding washout interval.
